notes: 3D bake (owner 2026-09-18): the water plane's height; the coast crosses it where the shore loops say (build_terrain.gd reads it from world.json)
3D bake: land stands at least this far above the water plane and sea lies this far below it away from the shore
3D bake: the shore loops are rasterised at this many samples per vertex each way into a coverage value
3D bake: biome weights are sampled this far off (at most) along a noise field, so the edges between grounds interlock instead of blurring
3D bake: the wavelength of that warp field
3D bake: seeded dither on the second texture's share before it becomes the blend byte — no contour bands
3D bake: cliff weight is raised to this power after normalising — a narrow, outcrop-like edge (~60 m) where grass is wide
3D bake: likewise for scree
3D bake: the colour map's large lighter/darker patches (was 0.16, which hid the materials)
3D bake: the colour map's green-yellow drift (was 0.10)
3D bake: the coverage is blurred this far before it ramps the heights through the water plane, so a coarse mesh LOD still crosses it smoothly
3D bake: the beach fades out over this much of the land share round a vertex (a box of BEACH_M): 1 - share below it is full sand
3D bake: and over this many metres under BEACH_MAX_M

3D bake (owner 2026-09-18): what sand reads as from far away (sRGB). The colour map can only darken and sand_03's own mean is ~#6C604F, so a lighter value changes nothing (bracketed: #9C8A66 and #B8A47C both clip to 1.0); the beach is lightened by making dirt_floor its base (beach_sand_share)

3D bake: the beach is dirt_floor with sand_03 as its second texture at up to this share (kept under 0.5 so the two never trade first place: a flip draws 20 m blocks), varied by a noise field at beach_grain_wave_m so the shore carries grain
3D bake: the wavelength of that noise, short enough to vary across a 100 m beach (at 900 m the whole band switched at once, one flat fill)
3D bake (owner 2026-09-18): a river's mouth width in metres is river_k * sqrt(discharge), clamped to river_min_w_m..river_max_w_m
3D bake: the narrowest mouth
3D bake: the widest mouth
3D bake: the width at the source — a river grows from here as t^map_river_taper_gamma
3D bake: how far the bed lies under the ground it runs through
3D bake: the water stands this share of the depth over the bed

3D bake (final review, owner 2026-09-18: was SEA_Y + 0.3 in bake_world.py): a river's water line never stands lower than this far over the water plane it runs to, so the line keeps falling to the sea without ever dipping under it
3D bake: the bed falls at least this much per 20 m step, so every river runs downhill to the sea
3D bake: the banks rise this many metres per metre out from the water's edge (a valley)
3D bake: a bank never reaches further out than this
3D bake: the wet-soil band beside the water reaches this far
3D bake: how strongly that band pulls dirt_floor in
3D bake: how much it darkens the colour map (bracketed 0.15 / 0.35 / 0.55 on 2026-09-18: dirt_floor reads lighter than grass, so below ~0.5 the band read as a sand road, not wet earth)
3D bake: the last stretch widens (x2) and shades to the sea's near band
3D bake: B-spline points per pack segment before a course is resampled (the 2D map's curve, map_river_smoothing_steps, but finer: at 20 m a vertex its 3 left straight 400 m runs)

3D bake (2026-09-18): the synthetic ridges fade to nothing over this distance from a river's course, so the carve never cuts a gorge through a ridge the noise threw across a valley (the 2D relief detail holds itself down near rivers the same way)
3D bake (2026-09-18): a river ending inland is carried on to the nearest point of another river's course within this distance (the pack stops its tributaries 60-290 m short of their confluence)

3D bake (owner 2026-09-19: a snow texture on the peaks, Poly Haven snow_field_aerial): the share of the highest ground where snow starts to come in on the 3D map's own relief — the 2D map's peak band (biome 15) and glaciers wear it too, through the bake's biome mix
3D bake: the share of the highest ground where the snow is full
3D bake: the snow line's weight against the other grounds (the grass is 1); thinned by 60% on the steepest cliff faces

3D bake fields: the wavelength of the noise that frays where the farmland ends, so its edge is no circle round the village
3D bake fields: how far (as a share of reach_m) that noise pulls the farmland's edge in or out
3D bake fields: a field's texture weight against the natural ground under it (the grass is 1) at the heart of the farmland

3D bake: each manor cell's own green-yellow shift, +- this share
